Mayes Middleton

Republican candidate for Attorney General, Texas · Open seat

State senator; president of Middleton Oil Company

Texas Senate since 2023 after four years in the Texas House. Won the May 26 runoff over U.S. Rep. Chip Roy with 55.2%. University of Texas School of Law graduate.

Where Middleton stands

Border
Says he would enforce President Trump's border agenda.
Abortion
Says he would uphold the state's anti-abortion laws.
Energy
Says he would protect oil and gas jobs.
